name: tips
description: One short tip at a time about the part of Vyre you are using, the parts you have not tried, and what an update brought. Each module ships its own tips; this one chooses, never nags, and turns off in Settings.

settings.label: Show tips
settings.help: One short line at a time about what you are using. Off hides every tip, on every device.

settings.label: Time between tips
settings.help: At most one tip per screen in this many minutes, and six a day in all.

tips.text: Run `vyre box` on your Mac for the box's address and whether it answers from here.
Update the box from your Mac with `vyre box update`. It says when the Mac needs the same version.
Back up everything, Claude's sign-in and /work included, with `vyre box backup ~/Backups/box.tar.gz`.
Move the box to a new server with `vyre box move alex@192.0.2.20`. It keeps its name.
On the server, `vyre logs` follows vyred's output. A log file per day sits in `~/.vyre/logs/`.
Preview what the box installer would change with `sh -s -- --dry-run`. It changes nothing.
Turn on agents' computers: add `COMPOSE_PROFILES=computers` to `/srv/vyre/.env`, then run `vyre up`.
Box backups hold your sealed vault. Keep them private, or encrypt them with `age`.
`vyre box` says no box yet? Run `vyre box add alex@192.0.2.10` once and it carries on from where the box stands.
`vyre box remove` keeps the volumes. Add `--purge` only when the vault, sign-in and /work should go too.
Press `Enter` while a turn runs to steer it: your words join the running turn at its next step.
Type `/` for the session's commands and skills; `Tab` completes a name without running it.
Paste an image with `Cmd+V` to send it with your words: up to 5, 5 MB each, PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP.
Press `Alt+Enter` to queue a message for after the current turn instead of steering it. Images can't be queued yet.
Start a message with `!` to run a shell command in the session's folder; Claude sees the output next turn.
Press `Esc` twice with nothing typed to rewind to an earlier message, with or without its code changes.
Press `Alt+T` to turn thinking on or off, and `Ctrl+O` to show or hide what it thought.
Start a message with `#` to save a memory, then pick This project, About you or Just this folder.
Press Folders, pick a folder, then Open in terminal for a shell on the box that outlives a closed tab.
Leave a session alone: it closes after 10 idle minutes and your next message resumes it where it was.
Install the plugin inside Claude Code with `/plugin marketplace add vyre-ai/vyre`, then `/plugin install vyre@vyre`.
Type `/vyre` for what this machine runs, this folder's project, your agents and how many things need you.
Ask an agent without leaving the session: `/vyre ask kit draft the Northwind Bakery invoice`.
tips.command: /vyre ask kit draft the Northwind Bakery invoice

tips.text: Set a reminder with `/vyre remind 6pm call Harlow Legal`. It rings by push, the Capsule and the Deck.
Search your past sessions from inside Claude Code with `/vyre recall <query>`.
Save a fact for every future session with `/vyre remember <fact>`.
Type into another session with `/vyre send <session> <text>`. The reply streams there, not here.
`/vyre agenda` shows today, then your todos, overdue ones too. `/vyre agenda tomorrow` shows the next day.
A `/vyre` command says a tool is missing? Run `vyre up`, then `vyre modules` to see which module failed.
`/vyre lessons` lists your lessons with how often each was applied, caught and broken.
Run `vyre help recall` for one command's usage and flags. `vyre help` alone lists every command.
Mistype a command and `vyre` offers the closest real one, so `vyre recal` points you to `vyre recall`.
`vyre up` is safe to run any time. After an upgrade it restarts an older vyred; otherwise it prints the same ready block.
Add `--json` to `vyre status`, `vyre recall` or any `vyre vault` command to get one line of JSON a script can parse.
`vyre doctor --json` exits 1 when a check fails, so a cron job or CI step can catch a broken box.
When a command stops with an error, run it again with `VYRE_DEBUG=1` in front to see the full trace.
Something feels off? Run `vyre doctor`. It checks vyred, the link, the box, pairing and Claude in under 2 seconds and says what to fix.
Every tool is scriptable. `vyre tools` lists them, and `vyre call projects.list` runs one and prints its JSON.
Type `vyre` on its own to open the home: every project, a new session and your agents. Arrows move, typing filters, Enter opens.
Press `Cmd-K` to search every session's words, then Up, Down and Enter to open a hit.
Press Take the keyboard when a thread says another surface is typing, and your words go in next.
Type `@kit check the Northwind Bakery invoices` in Find to ask kit directly, not your assistant.
Type `tell harlow to draft the reply` in Find to type into that session, then watch it.
With a fact open in Memory, press `p` to pin it, `m` to mute it or `c` to correct it.
Type `tell me when harlow is done` in Find, and Vyre watches that session and tells you when it ends.
Open `/settings#devices` to jump to one Settings section, and bookmark the ones you use.
Open the Deck when the box is out of reach: Now shows the counts from your last visit, never a draft's words.
Set `theme.colors` in the box's config.json to recolour the Deck on every device, then reload it.
Run `vyre modules` for every module, its version, and whether it started or why it failed.
Install a module by putting its folder in `~/.vyre/modules/`, then `vyre down && vyre up`.
Run any module's tool from the terminal with `vyre call <tool>` and its input as JSON.
tips.command: vyre call notes.add '{"text":"call the printer people"}'

tips.text: Switch a module off with `modules.disable` in config.json, whatever its roles say.
Try a module without touching your real home: `export VYRE_HOME=$(mktemp -d)`, then `vyre up --json`.
Name a module's tools after it, like `notes.add`, and its tables with `notes_`. The loader refuses anything else.
Add Vyre to your Home Screen from Safari's Share button, then open it from the icon to run it full screen.
Open Settings, Notifications and press Turn on notifications to hear when a draft or a question waits.
Pull down from the top of Now, Chats or Agents to open Find.
Hold the send button to queue a message for after the turn; on a phone, Enter makes a new line.
Set Quiet hours in Settings, Notifications for 22:00 to 07:00; what happens then waits in Now.
Tap to click in Glass, long press to right click, and scroll with two fingers.
Hold the Capsule's mic to dictate; let go and your words land in Find, not sent yet.
Open Find with an empty box to see your last 8 searches and the 4 newest sessions.
